1.commentaire: This passage invites us to reflect on the beauty that God sees in us, beyond our outward appearance. As believers, we are called to cultivate this inner beauty that reflects our relationship with Christ, and to appreciate God's creation in our lives. May our love for God and for others be a source of beauty that draws those around us to His light.
